title: Your scholarship overpaid you - return the balance
scenario: Your account shows a scholarship deposit far larger than expected. An email says it was a processing error and asks you to wire back the difference today to avoid losing the scholarship entirely.

answers.A: Wire back the difference today to keep the scholarship.
answers.B: Spend some of it first, since it's already in your account.
answers.C: Contact the financial aid office directly to confirm the deposit before sending any money back.

explanation: Scholarship overpayment scams rely on students trusting an unexpected deposit; the real fix for an aid-office error never requires you to wire money out first.
proTip: A financial aid office fixes its own mistakes - it doesn't need you to wire money to do it.
